subject: science
passage: Honey can stay safe to eat for a very long time when it is stored in a sealed container. The low water content and natural acidity of ______ make it very difficult for bacteria and molds to grow. Bees help create these conditions by fanning the nectar with their wings, which makes much of its water evaporate.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

explanation.why: The subject of the second sentence is "The low water content and natural acidity of honey," and its verb is "make." No punctuation should separate a subject from its verb, even when the subject is long.
explanation.A: Incorrect. A single comma can't separate the subject from its verb, "make."
explanation.B: Correct. The long subject flows straight into its verb, "make," with no punctuation.
explanation.C: Incorrect. A semicolon joins two independent clauses; here it would cut the subject off from its verb.
explanation.D: Incorrect. A colon must follow a complete independent clause, and "The low water content and natural acidity of honey" is not one.
